title: Black Knit & Dark Studio Gradient
prompt: An original young woman with dark hair pulled back at the crown rests one arm across her forehead, with the other arm extended toward the lens. She wears a fitted black long-sleeve knit with a high neck. Her lips are warm coral, and her expression is calm and direct. A deep charcoal backdrop with soft gradient light falls off into shadow. Low-key studio lighting, a palette of charcoal, black, and warm coral. Dramatic and sleek, in the style of a beauty campaign.
workingNotes:
- The coral lip is the only warm accent against the dark tones.
- Add 'dramatic side lighting' to sharpen the cheekbones.
tryThis: Try this: Add dramatic side lighting.
